name: Carasso Motors Ltd.
summary: Carasso Motors Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the import, distribution, and sale of automobiles in Israel. It operates through Vehicles, Services, Leasing, Financing, and Others segments. The company imports, markets, and distributes four-wheeled and two-wheeled vehicles, SUVs, ATVs, motorcycles, scooters, electric operational vehicles, and marine and operational vehicles, as well as boats and marine engines.
